name: AetherLumen Pro LED Face Mask
alt: LED face mask on a dark neutral background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same LED face mask photograph
summary: Cordless, rechargeable face mask with seven light colors, including red, blue, and near-infrared.
description: The AetherLumen Pro LED Face Mask is a cordless, rechargeable mask for at-home use. It has seven light colors, including red, blue, and near-infrared. Follow the instructions that come in the box. This page does not promise a medical or cosmetic result.
specs: Daily at-home sessions, as the included manual describes
howToUse: Read the manual in the box before the first session.
Charge the mask first if the manual says to.
Use it on clean, dry skin unless the manual says otherwise.
Stop if your skin stings, you feel unwell, or the device gets unusually hot.
Keep it away from water and from children.
whatToExpect: This is a light-therapy mask for a regular at-home routine. People respond differently, and this store does not have published customer results for this product yet.
There is no before-and-after photo on this page. We only publish a customer photo after that person sends it and we approve it.

name: Pulse Recovery Massage Gun
alt: Percussion massage gun on a neutral background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same massage gun photograph
summary: Percussion massage gun with multiple speed settings and interchangeable heads.
description: The Pulse Recovery Massage Gun is a percussion massager for at-home muscle massage. It has multiple speed settings and interchangeable heads. It is a consumer device, not a substitute for medical care.
howToUse: Read the manual before first use, including which head is meant for which area.
Start on a lower speed.
Keep the head moving. Do not press into the front of the neck, the spine, or a recent injury.
Stop if you feel sharp pain, numbness, or bruising.
whatToExpect: People use a massage gun for short recovery sessions at home. How it feels depends on the speed, the head, and the person.
This store does not have published customer results for this product yet, and there is no before-and-after photo here.

name: Posture AI Corrector
alt: Wearable posture device shown on a model from behind, on a neutral background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same posture device photograph
summary: Wearable posture device with a gentle vibration alert. Lightweight and adjustable.
description: The Posture AI Corrector is a wearable device that gives a gentle vibration alert. It is lightweight and adjustable, and it is described as something you can wear under clothing. A vibration is a reminder. It is not a medical treatment and it does not diagnose a posture condition.
howToUse: Adjust the fit so it is snug and not painful.
Follow the wear-time guidance in the included instructions.
Stop if you feel numbness, pain, or skin irritation.
Do not rely on it while driving or doing anything that needs your full attention if the vibration distracts you.
whatToExpect: The device is meant to remind you with a vibration while you wear it. Whether that changes how you sit depends on you.
We do not have customer results to publish for this product yet.

name: Red Light Therapy Belt
alt: Flexible red light therapy belt on a neutral background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same red light therapy belt photograph
summary: Flexible wrap with red and near-infrared light and adjustable straps.
description: The Red Light Therapy Belt is a flexible wrap with red and near-infrared light for targeted at-home use. It closes with adjustable straps. Session length and placement should follow the included manual. This listing does not promise a medical result.
howToUse: Read the manual for placement and session length before you turn it on.
Use it on intact skin, or over a thin cloth if the manual allows that.
Do not fall asleep while it is powered on.
Unplug or power it down if it feels excessively hot, and stop if your skin is irritated.
whatToExpect: This is a light wrap for short sessions on a specific area. What you notice, if anything, depends on the person and on following the manual.
There is no before-and-after photo here. We have no published customer results for this product yet.

name: Sunrise Smart Alarm Clock
alt: Sunrise-style alarm clock with a wood accent on a dark background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same sunrise alarm photograph
summary: Alarm that brightens gradually, with white noise and adjustable light intensity.
description: The Sunrise Smart Alarm Clock is a bedside alarm that brightens gradually. It includes white noise and an adjustable light level, in a design with a wood accent. It is a light and an alarm. It is not a medical sleep device.
howToUse: Place it where you can see the light from bed, at the distance the manual recommends.
Set the alarm time and the light level before the night you want to use it.
Turn on white noise only if you want sound with the light.
Keep the power cord where it will not be pulled or tripped over.
whatToExpect: The light comes up before the alarm time you set, instead of a sudden sound in a dark room. Whether that makes waking easier varies.
We do not have published customer results for this product yet.

name: Electric Scalp Massager
alt: Handheld electric scalp massager with soft nodes on a neutral background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same scalp massager photograph
summary: Handheld electric scalp massager with soft nodes.
description: The Electric Scalp Massager is a handheld device with soft nodes for an at-home scalp massage. It is a massage tool. It is not a treatment for hair loss, and this page does not promise hair growth.
howToUse: Use it on dry hair unless the manual says wet hair is allowed.
Keep it moving and use light pressure.
Do not use it on broken skin or on a scalp that is already irritated.
Charge or plug it in only in the way the manual describes.
whatToExpect: Most people use this for a short massage. It should feel like pressure from the soft nodes, not like a medical treatment.
We do not have published customer results for this product yet.

name: Jade Roller & Gua Sha Set
alt: Jade roller and gua sha set with its box on a light background
detailAlt: Closer crop of the same jade roller and gua sha photograph
summary: A roller and a gua sha stone, sold as a set of natural jade facial tools.
description: The Jade Roller & Gua Sha Set includes a roller and a gua sha stone, described as natural jade, in gift-style packaging. The tools are for a gentle at-home facial massage. Natural stone color varies. This page does not promise a change in facial structure or skin.
specs: Natural jade, as described for this set
howToUse: Wash both tools with mild soap and water and dry them before the first use.
Use a face oil or serum if you want the stone to glide, and use light pressure.
Roll outward from the center of the face. For the gua sha, use short strokes and stay away from the eyes.
Do not use the tools on broken skin. Do not use a stone that is cracked or chipped.
Stone can chip if it is dropped.
whatToExpect: A session is a few minutes of light massage. The stone will feel cool at the start. That is the tool working as a smooth stone, not a measured clinical effect.
We do not publish before-and-after photos, and we have no customer reviews for this set yet.
